description: This is a Java source file defining the BOMHelper class, which provides static utility methods for handling Bills of Materials (BOM) operations such as calculating product hierarchy depth, detecting duplicates, and creating production runs for shipments within the OFBiz manufacturing context.

classes.name: BOMHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for BOM operations such as calculating product hierarchy depth, detecting duplicate ancestors, and creating production runs for shipments.

methods.name: getMaxDepth
methods.description: Calculates the maximum depth (low level code) of a product in the BOM hierarchy based on parent-child associations, indicating the product's level relative to root components.

methods.name: searchDuplicatedAncestor
methods.description: Searches for an ancestor of a product that has a specified productIdKey, useful to detect loops or duplicates in BOM structures.

methods.name: createProductionRunsForShipment
methods.description: Creates production runs related to a specific shipment by invoking relevant OFBiz services, facilitating manufacturing process automation.
